convention: anthropics/skills/skill-creator evals.json per references/schemas.md. Every entry carries `should_trigger` so skill-creator's description-optimisation loop can score train/held-out trigger accuracy; the start-from-nothing fixtures (ids 1-2) additionally carry `expected_output` + `expectations[]` — graded answer-quality axes in the same shape as re-frame2-xray's Layer-2 evals — so routing AND outcome are both evaluated (rf2-rc0yh).
notes: Positives target greenfield re-frame2 bootstrap (empty dir, or shadow-cljs project with no re-frame2 wiring). Negatives target authoring on a working v2 project, v1 migration, live-runtime, or 'adding re-frame2 to an existing non-trivial app' (which is authoring, not setup). Execution contract (rf2-rc0yh): an unqualified greenfield request takes the ZERO-INTERVIEW default — Reagent, the generator template's pinned baseline as the version pin, your-app namespace / :app build id / port 8280 — and the skill EXECUTES: it writes the files, runs npm install, runs a terminating `npx shadow-cljs compile app`, starts the watch, and reports the URL without claiming the browser mounted from compile success alone. Both routes are the skill's to run: the manual scaffold is the default's exact-files path, and the `clojure -Tnew create …` generator is a complete alternative the skill runs itself when the author asks for it (allowed-tools cover -Tnew). setup_drift_test Lock 12 (pin-default-is-zero-interview + skill-executes-the-scaffold-and-reports-the-url) guards this contract.

evals.name: start-from-nothing
evals.prompt: Start me a new re-frame2 ClojureScript project from an empty directory. I want deps.edn, shadow-cljs.edn, and a counter that mounts.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks no clarifying question. It writes the default Reagent project — deps.edn (day-one coords at the generator template's pinned baseline), package.json, shadow-cljs.edn, resources/public/index.html + css/app.css, src/your_app/core.cljs — runs npm install and a terminating `npx shadow-cljs compile app` itself, starts the watch, and hands off with the successful command, the URL http://localhost:8280/, and an ask-the-author-to-click 0→1 line.
expectations: The response asks NO clarifying question — no version / substrate / devtools interview; it proceeds on Reagent with the generator template's pinned baseline as the pin.

The files written are the default manifest — deps.edn, package.json, shadow-cljs.edn, resources/public/index.html (+ css/app.css), and src/your_app/core.cljs — with the day-one coords at ONE pin and no unresolved <VERSION>/<SHA> placeholder left in any written file.
The skill runs the commands itself — npm install, then a terminating `npx shadow-cljs compile app`, then starts `npx shadow-cljs watch app` — rather than telling the author which commands to run.

The handoff names the successful verification command and the served URL (http://localhost:8280/) and does NOT claim the counter mounted from compile success alone — it asks the author to open the page and click +1 (expecting 0→1).

evals.name: scaffold-cmd
evals.prompt: Scaffold a re-frame2 app for me.
evals.expected_output: The unqualified request takes the zero-interview default end to end: Reagent, template-baseline pin, your-app namespace / :app build id / port 8280, smallest runnable counter; files written, install + terminating compile executed by the skill, watch started, concise factual handoff with the URL and the single next skill (re-frame2).
expectations: The response takes the zero-interview default: no questions about version, substrate, or tooling — Reagent + the template-baseline pin, your-app namespace, :app build id, port 8280.
A deterministic Reagent project is written with the day-one set (core + -reagent + -schemas + -xray at ONE pin, plus an explicit reagent/reagent) and no placeholders.
Install and the terminating compile verification are executed by the skill (npm install; `npx shadow-cljs compile app` exit 0), with the watch started and the URL reported.
The handoff is concise and factual — files created, command verified, URL, and the single next skill (re-frame2) — with no option matrix, capability tour, or wizard.
